body: task cws:publish / cws:upload fail at the token step with invalid_grant when CWS_REFRESH_TOKEN is expired or revoked (hit 2026-11-05 releasing 0.1.15). Fix: run node scripts/cws-oauth.mjs from the repo root (the owner logs in to Google in the browser; it writes a fresh CWS_REFRESH_TOKEN to .env) and back the new value up wherever the other release secrets are kept. If the OAuth consent screen is in Testing mode, Google expires the token after 7 days; set it to In production to stop this recurring.
title: CWS publish fails invalid_grant: refresh token expired
